claims.claim_ar: الالتفات في مطلع الآية بالنداء «يا أيها الذين آمنوا» لتوجيه الخطاب وجذب الانتباه والاهتمام بالموضوع.
claims.claim_en: A shift to direct address (iltifat) at the opening: 'O you who believe' — it draws attention and focuses the addressees on the warning.

claims.claim_ar: الاستفهام الإنشائي في «أتريدون أن تجعلوا…؟» يستعمل كأسلوب إنشائي بلاغي للإنكار والاعتراض والتحذير من العاقبة.
claims.claim_en: A rhetorical interrogative (injunctive/interrogative used as a speech-act) in 'Do you wish that you should make...' — used to reproach/object and to warn of consequences.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited chunk mentions 'tinting the discourse' and attention-getting devices but does not explicitly label this specific interrogative as إنشائي; corroboration with additional tafsir/بلاغة sources is recommended.

claims.claim_ar: تطابق/تضاد لفظي بين «الْكَافِرِينَ» و«الْمُؤْمِنِينَ» ليبرز التباين الأخلاقي والولائي ويقوّي نبرة التحذير.
claims.claim_en: Antithesis (tibaq) between 'the disbelievers' and 'the believers' to emphasize the moral/loyal contrast and strengthen the warning.
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided chunks do not explicitly discuss this verse's antithesis; the device is inferred from the juxtaposition of the two groups in the text and should be checked against other rhetorical commentaries.
